intro: The excavators broke the seal on a tomb that appears on no dynasty list. Every chamber is empty except for a single inscription, carved in a script that is not quite sacred. The head copyist has begun her day's work, and already a small pile of slips lies beside her inkwell, each one carefully scraped clean and set aside, as if she could not trust the first telling of any line. She will not say why, only that the stone seems to shift its meaning when copied too hastily, and that a copy that agrees too perfectly with the wall is the one most likely to betray you. The crew has learned not to ask which of her finished pages has been discarded, only to tiptoe past the heap.
echo: Four triangular faces, pointing at the sun, over a very small room.

meta.title: Meta: Valley Of The Kings
meta.flavor: Nothing reached the tomb undamaged. The damage, though, was remarkably consistent.
hints: Did every answer come out clean the first time? Each had exactly one wrong letter. Did you keep them?
